purpose: Teach: 西郷/母性/強まる/デリケート/青く/突っ込む/打ち込む/兼ね備え

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、西郷、絶対、町、絶対、で起きた、絶対、事件、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're currently investigating an incident that occurred in Saigo town. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Clear enunciation on key facts. Slight pause before gratitude. Professional distance but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、母性、絶対、保護、絶対、警察、絶対、配慮、絶対、されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I understand the victim's welfare is being carefully protected by the police throughout this process.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Seeking confirmation rather than stating fact. Gentle pace. Genuine concern underneath the formal phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。事件の、本気で、絶対、緊張感、絶対、強まる、絶対、中、絶対、警察、絶対、対応、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Given the sensitive nature of this case, we're treating every aspect with the utmost care.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Deliberate emphasis on 'utmost care.' Not defensive but wanting to be understood. Professional composure maintained throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 証言、本気で、絶対、デリケート、絶対、な内容、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、扱われているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The testimony we're collecting is quite delicate, and we're handling it with appropriate discretion.
lines.style: Thoughtful, acknowledging the weight of what's being said. Quiet confidence. A small pause before 'discretion'—showing he understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。現場の、本気で、絶対、青く、絶対、光る、絶対、ライト、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査の目印、絶対、です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The blue lights you see at the scene are markers of our ongoing investigation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact explanation. Slight uptick on 'blue lights'—making the concrete visible. Then settling back to procedural calm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、車に、絶対、突っ込む、絶対、ような、絶対、危険な行動、絶対、警察、絶対、阻止されたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect's attempt to flee—to drive into the crowd—was prevented by our officers on scene.
lines.style: Controlled but with underlying gravity. Slight tension on the potential danger. Then a release into competence. Speaking factually but aware of how serious this was.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、捜査に、絶対、打ち込む、絶対、姿勢、絶対、市民、絶対、信頼してくださっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The public has shown real confidence in our commitment to thoroughly investigating and resolving this matter.
lines.style: Quieter, more personal than procedural. Genuine respect for public trust. Slower pace. A subtle warmth behind the formality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、判断力と、絶対、行動力を、絶対、兼ね備え、絶対、現場対応、絶対、見事ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The officers involved demonstrated both sound judgment and swift action throughout this response. It reflects well on our department.
lines.style: Measured respect. Pride that's earned rather than performed. Thoughtful pacing. Recognition of effort without self-congratulation.
